summary: Full E2E test of Emergent Object Storage migration for media uploads. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass — startup log confirms 'Emergent object storage ready', PNG + MP4 uploads succeed with correct /api/uploads/{folder}/{name} URL shape, content-type & bytes are byte-identical on retrieval, uploaded files are NOT written to local disk (object storage path), persistence survives `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, legacy local slides files still served via fallback, 404 for missing files works, and DB media list contains new uploads with /api/uploads/ prefix. Frontend regression: /services/etudes-fondations loads, hero + gallery images (3 /api/uploads/services/*.png) all render (naturalWidth > 0, no 4xx/5xx responses). No frontend files were modified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_media only removes local disk file, not the object-storage object — orphaned objects will accumulate. Consider adding a storage.delete_object() call for URLs that are not present on local disk.
server.py is ~1200+ lines — should be split into routers (auth, admin_media, admin_content, crud) for maintainability.

storage.py _init_failed latch prevents recovery: if the integrations proxy is transiently down at startup, storage stays disabled for the entire process lifetime. Consider a TTL-based retry (e.g. reset _init_failed after 60s).
seed_data_creation: Test PNG (2x2) and small binary .mp4 uploaded to folder 'storage-test' via POST /api/admin/media — 2 objects created in object storage + 2 db.media documents. Not cleaned up (no admin storage-delete route that also removes object).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Object storage integration is fully working. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_object_storage.py can be re-run any time. If future bug: `delete_media` does not delete objects from object storage — only local disk. Backend logs at /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log show 'Emergent object storage ready' after each restart.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration validated a fix. Root fix: ephemeral local disk replaced with persistent Emergent Object Storage (storage.py). Uploads persist across `supervisorctl restart backend` — verified by uploading a PNG, restarting backend, re-fetching and asserting bytes are identical.
